title: TinyMU: Compact Audio-Language Model for Music Understanding
summary: TinyMU is an efficient 229M-parameter model designed for deep music understanding, achieving 82% of SOTA performance while being 35x smaller than major models. It leverages the MATPAC++ audio encoder and the MusicSkills-3.5M dataset to provide fine-grained musical reasoning.
research_notes: Trained on the MusicSkills-3.5M dataset; outperforms larger predecessors like MusiLingo and Audio-Flamingo on music reasoning benchmarks.

evolution.summary: Accepted by ICASSP 2026 and publicly released in April 2026, TinyMU proves that high-quality supervision and specialized encoders can replace massive parameter scale. The research evolved into fine-grained pre-training with FineLAP and MeanAudio later in 2026.
